'''Chirioff''' was the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] head [[Clown/Legends|clown]] of [[Kersh Lauskner's Traveling Animal/Acrobatic Arcadium]], responsible for hiring and firing the other clowns. He was adept at juggling, sleight of hand, and slapstick.
